posts.title: Doomed by Markets and Chance
posts.description: An author’s unusually candid postmortem on a failed fantasy duology reveals some of the deep problems in the modern publishing industry.

posts.title: A Change of Pace and a Fun Bit of History

posts.title: Silver Bells from Hiroshima
posts.description: I inherited a few copies of an unusual children’s magazine, published in the wake of one of the most horrifying events in history. Here’s how it looks.
